sources.researchNote: The uploader identifies Parlophon B 4502, matrix 38185, a Berlin recording in January 1930, Max Mensing and music by Dr. B. Kaper. A Parlophon label appears in the video, but its catalogue and matrix details were not independently transcribed at sufficient resolution during this review; they remain supplied by the description. The structured date is the YouTube publication date. The portrait used as the video thumbnail is not evidence identifying the recording personnel. This reference belongs to the German song W-S008, not the Polish-language version.
